my_own_diagnosis: From xbase alone the new musty odour in an otherwise unchanged routine points to a machine-hygiene problem; the focal feature (door always shut immediately, gasket never cleaned) clinches the diagnosis as gasket mould/mildew trapping moisture and transferring odour to laundry each cycle.
focal_notes: The combination of door always kept closed and gasket never cleaned is a well-known, textbook cause of front-loader musty odour and unambiguously points to the gasket as the primary suspect.
